## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic; at least one regression test in tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py invokes validate-review-output.sh live (not mocked) to exercise the actual shell contract

## TDD Requirement
Write the following failing tests in tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py BEFORE any implementation changes to runner.py. All tests must fail (RED) initially because _validate_findings_schema() does not yet exist:

1. test_validate_findings_schema_pass_returns_pass_status: Given valid findings JSON written to a tmpfile, when _validate_findings_schema(merged_dict) is called, then it returns a _SchemaValidationResult with status="pass" and empty errors list. Invokes validate-review-output.sh LIVE (not mocked) per story DD3.

2. test_validate_findings_schema_missing_cited_excerpt_returns_schema_fail: Given findings JSON with a real finding missing cited_excerpt, when _validate_findings_schema(merged_dict) is called, then returns _SchemaValidationResult with status="schema_fail" and non-empty errors list. Uses live validate-review-output.sh.

3. test_validate_findings_schema_validator_not_found_returns_validator_error: Given a patched _resolve_validator_script() that returns a nonexistent path, when _validate_findings_schema(merged_dict) is called, then returns _SchemaValidationResult with status="validator_error" and non-empty errors.

4. test_validate_findings_schema_validator_timeout_returns_validator_error: Given subprocess patched to raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired, when _validate_findings_schema(merged_dict) is called, then returns _SchemaValidationResult with status="validator_error".

5. test_validate_findings_schema_unknown_exit_code_returns_validator_error: Given subprocess patched to return exit code 42, when _validate_findings_schema(merged_dict) is called, then returns _SchemaValidationResult with status="validator_error".

6. test_main_validator_error_exits_nonzero_with_stderr_diagnostic: Given mocked dispatch that returns findings and _validate_findings_schema() patched to return validator_error result, when main() runs, then exit code is non-zero and stderr contains "CRITICAL:".

7. test_main_schema_fail_returns_schema_fail_signal (integration point for S-B): Given mocked dispatch returning schema-invalid findings, when main() runs with real validate-review-output.sh, then the function returns an exit code that signals schema_fail (implementation-plan-level: document the return value as 0 with a schema_fail sentinel in merged findings for S-B to pick up; see Note below).

Note on S-B integration point: DD2 says "schema-fail signal handed off to the correction handoff point (S-B integration point)". For this story (S-A), we only insert the validation hook. The schema_fail path does NOT dispatch correction (that is S-B's scope). The S-A implementation exits 0 with the findings intact (allowing S-B to intercept), OR the validator signal is an in-process return value rather than an exit code. The sub-agent implementing this task must read the story's "Considerations" section and confirm the S-B integration contract before writing the test. Default assumption: schema_fail returns the _SchemaValidationResult to main(), which will be consumed by S-B's correction dispatch in the next story. Test asserts the _SchemaValidationResult is accessible from main() at the integration point.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then per function)

Test 1 (live validator):
- Given: a dict with a valid finding containing all required fields (severity, category, description, file, cited_lines, cited_excerpt; plus reachability for critical severity)
- When: _validate_findings_schema(findings_dict) is called (invokes validate-review-output.sh live)
- Then: returns _SchemaValidationResult(status="pass", errors=[])

Test 2 (live validator, schema_fail path):
- Given: a dict with a finding where cited_excerpt is missing or empty (a real finding, not a synthetic type)
- When: _validate_findings_schema(findings_dict) is called
- Then: returns _SchemaValidationResult(status="schema_fail", errors=[<non-empty list>])

Tests 3-5 (mocked subprocess):
- Given: patched subprocess.run or FileNotFoundError/TimeoutExpired
- When: _validate_findings_schema(findings_dict) is called
- Then: returns _SchemaValidationResult(status="validator_error", errors=[<non-empty list>])

## .test-index Update
.test-index already maps plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py → tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py. No new entry needed — the fuzzy match is satisfied (runnerpy is substring of testrunnersmokey). RED marker must be added for the new test functions.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: PYTHONPATH=plugins/dso/scripts pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py -k "test_validate_findings_schema or test_main_validator_error or test_main_schema_fail" 2>&1; test $? -ne 0
  (Must FAIL before Task T2 is implemented — this is the RED check)
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] All 7 test functions exist in test_runner_smoke.py
  Verify: grep -c "def test_validate_findings_schema\|def test_main_validator_error\|def test_main_schema_fail" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py | awk '{exit ($1 < 5)}'
- [ ] At least one test invokes validate-review-output.sh live (no subprocess mock for that test)
  Verify: grep -A 20 "def test_validate_findings_schema_pass_returns_pass_status\|def test_validate_findings_schema_missing_cited_excerpt" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py | grep -v "patch\|mock" | grep -q "subprocess\|_validate_findings_schema"
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers [test_validate_findings_schema_pass_returns_pass_status] and [test_validate_findings_schema_missing_cited_excerpt_returns_schema_fail]
  Verify: grep '\[test_validate_findings_schema_pass_returns_pass_status\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Tests are behavioral (invoke code under test, assert on return values or exit codes — no grep-of-source checks)
  Verify: manual review — test approach above describes callable invocation with return-value assertions

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
